sections.name: projects (Projekty)

sections.name: reference (Kompendium)
sections.notes: 9 cards translated; O autorze and Licencja are real links to the two other approved PL pages; PDF/EPUB remain real links explicitly labeled "wersja rosyjska"; the remaining 5 cards (index, wprowadzenie, recenzent, CLI, official resources) render disabled since those target pages are not translated.

sections.name: footer
sections.notes: Shared site_footer(locale='pl') renders the Polish brand line and a real link to the approved PL license page.

notes: Full homepage shell rebuilt via scripts/build_site_index_pl.py, independent of the RU builder. Automated scan confirms zero Cyrillic codepoints in visible text or aria-label/title/alt attributes (scripts/validate_pl_leakage.py). Terminology scan confirms required nav/section labels (Praktyka, Rozdział, Kompendium) and rejects forbidden synonyms (scripts/validate_pl_terminology.py). Link scan confirms no dead or misleading /pl/ hrefs (only o-autorze.html, licencja.html, the RU-labeled PDF/EPUB, and the shared RU|PL switcher are real anchors). Reviewed as mechanical QA + linguistic audit per M02-I03 governance; final production merge still requires Product Owner sign-off on Polish phrasing and visual review.
